scripts.emulators: npm --workspace apps/firebase-functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project grids-one --only ${FIREBASE_EMULATORS:-auth,firestore,functions,storage}
scripts.emulators:import: npm --workspace apps/firebase-functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project grids-one --only ${FIREBASE_EMULATORS:-auth,firestore,functions,storage} --import=./emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.lint: npm --workspace apps/web run lint && npm --workspace apps/firebase-functions run lint
scripts.test: npm --workspace apps/web run test:run && npm --workspace apps/firebase-functions run test
scripts.type-check: npm --workspace apps/web run type-check && npm --workspace apps/firebase-functions run type-check
scripts.suite:full: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run type-check && echo 'Success!'
